Three areas, one point of contact.

GRENFORD brings Investment, Property and Projects together. When a project touches more than one area, such as buying, renovating and selling a fix-and-flip property, the Valuation, Renovation Memo and Property Brief work hand in hand, managed by one dedicated point of contact. For specialist questions, GRENFORD works with an established network of experts, architects, contractors and lenders.

About the business idea ↗
Marco KaimannFounder of GRENFORD

The GRENFORD 5-Point Process

Every mandate follows the same sequence. You decide how much of it you need.

  1. 01

    Understand

    Getting to know your project, your wishes and your goals.

    You receiveAn initial conversation, free of charge

  2. 02

    Assess

    Bringing together framework, documents and options.

    You receiveA first assessment and a list of missing documents

  3. 03

    Analyse

    Making information and differences easy to understand.

    You receiveYour memo: Investment Memo, Property Brief or Renovation Memo

  4. 04

    Decide

    Setting a well-founded direction and the next steps.

    You receiveYour decision, recorded in writing

  5. 05

    Accompany

    Up to the notary appointment or completion of works, within the agreed scope.

    You receiveOne point of contact until completion
